title: Stop display
summary: The screen at a stop (a passenger information display), in three full-screen layouts — a transit center's bays, a single route, or several routes at a street stop: which stop this is, the next three departures of each route to each destination with how long until each leaves (live when predicted), the bay at a station, the routes that have stopped for the day, and a slot for the service alerts and detours here.
questions: What leaves next here, on each route and to each destination — the next three of each?
How long until each one leaves?
Is that time live, or the schedule?
Which bay does it leave from (a transit center)?
Has a route stopped running here today?
Is there an alert or a detour at this stop?
